INDOOR / SURFACE & TRANSPARENCY

Light has

no fixed form.

A compact framed enclosure returns. Pale

colour and blue imagery show the structure

in contrasting states, revealing its edges,

translucent surfaces and the surrounding

room.

These final views close the performance

archive with the project’s central

relationship: a physical frame, an image that

changes, and space that remains visible

through both.
